FIRST_K_ELIGIBLE.h1_compatibility: compatible but systematically biased to episode openings, which no frozen authority requests
FIRST_K_ELIGIBLE.trajectory_coverage: POOR -- concentrates on the first 6 s

FIXED_SOURCE_TIME_STRIDE.fixed_budget_predictability: LOW -- yield collapses on short episodes
FIXED_SOURCE_TIME_STRIDE.h1_compatibility: compatible but reintroduces the V1 failure mode in a family-independent form
FIXED_SOURCE_TIME_STRIDE.trajectory_coverage: POOR on short episodes, absent below one stride

REALIZED_LEGACY_STAGE_ONLY.early_termination_sensitivity: EXTREME -- this is the measured V1 failure
REALIZED_LEGACY_STAGE_ONLY.h1_compatibility: compatible in principle, infeasible in practice
REALIZED_LEGACY_STAGE_ONLY.trajectory_coverage: NEARLY NONE -- almost every retained event is the 0.1H slot

REALIZED_TRAJECTORY_UNIFORM_K.early_termination_sensitivity: LOWEST -- a short episode still contributes every realized state
REALIZED_TRAJECTORY_UNIFORM_K.fixed_budget_predictability: HIGH -- yield is min(M, K) exactly
REALIZED_TRAJECTORY_UNIFORM_K.h1_compatibility: compatible: H1 is a pooled paired-episode task success claim with no per-stage or per-position component
REALIZED_TRAJECTORY_UNIFORM_K.trajectory_coverage: BEST -- first and last realized eligible states always included

selection_rationale: UNIFORM_K and FIRST_K yield the same number of events by construction (min(M, K)), so the choice between them is decided purely by trajectory coverage, which is a source-only property: UNIFORM_K spans a mean 0.895 of the realized trajectory against FIRST_K's 0.601. No label, class balance or candidate outcome entered this comparison.

v1_failure_reproduced.interpretation: the pilot independently reproduces the V1 acquisition yield without using any V1 data
